title: Semi-Supervised Learning with Noisy Proxy Covariates: Generalization Bounds and Distribution Regression
abstract: arXiv:2606.00512v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In many modern machine learning pipelines, abundant pretrained representations serve as noisy proxy covariates, while task-specific labels remain scarce. We study semi-supervised regression in this setting, and propose a simple two stage estimator that learns kernel eigenfeatures from all proxy covariates and fits a ridge predictor on labeled data. We derive finite sample bounds showing that fast labeled sample rates are recovered when proxy perturbation is controlled and unlabeled proxy covariates are sufficiently abundant. We also show that distribution regression is a direct special case, with analogous guarantees when the finite bag size is large enough. Experiments show consistent gains over supervised and semi-supervised baselines, especially in low label regimes.

translated_title: 基于噪声代理协变量的半监督学习：泛化界与分布回归
translated_abstract: 在许多现代机器学习流程中，大量预训练表示被用作含噪声的代理协变量，而特定任务的标签仍然稀缺。我们研究了这一设定下的半监督回归问题，并提出了一种简单的两阶段估计器：从所有代理协变量中学习核特征值特征，然后在有标签数据上拟合岭回归预测器。我们推导了有限样本界，表明当代理扰动得到控制且无标签代理协变量足够充足时，可以恢复快速的有标签样本收敛率。我们还证明分布回归是该框架的直接特例，当有限的袋大小足够大时，同样可以获得类似的保证。实验表明，该方法相比监督和半监督基线取得了一致的性能提升，尤其是在标签稀缺的场景下。
tldr: 该论文提出一种简单的两阶段半监督回归估计器——从大量含噪声的预训练代理协变量中学习核特征值特征、并在少量标签上拟合岭回归预测器，从理论上证明当代理扰动可控且无标签数据充足时可恢复快速标签样本率，并将分布回归作为特例纳入统一的泛化保证框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple two-stage semi-supervised regression estimator that learns kernel eigenfeatures from abundant noisy proxy covariates and fits a ridge predictor on scarce labels, proving fast labeled-sample rates under controlled proxy perturbation, with distribution regression as a special case covered by unified generalization guarantees.
